item.title: Login
item.description: Function Overview linkLog in to Solarhub (Web) with a platform account. After a successful login the data dashboard page is shown. Visit the Solarhub login page through Solarhub, enter the correct account and password and log in App download: the upper right corner of the login page provides the App download QR code; scan it with your phone to download the latest App released by the platform Multi-language switch: the upper right corner of the login page allows you to switch the display language After a successful login the data dashboard page is shown

item.title: Multi-language Switch
item.description: Function Overview linkThe platform supports multiple interface languages, which can be switched at any time before or after login; the switch takes effect immediately. Before login, switch the language through the icon in the upper right corner After login, switch the language next to the user in the upper right corner Multi-language texts on the platform (for example the name of a measurement group or the name of a device parameter) are shown in the corresponding language when the interface language is switched; if a name is not filled in for that language, the default name is shown.
